source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.4 with Example 4.2 (PDF 79-80).

blocks.text: Kaam ki tareef mein yeh saaf nahi ke kaam ki ek jaisi miqdar ek second mein hui ya ek ghante mein; amali istemalat mein aksar us raftar se dilchaspi hoti hai jis se kaam hota hai.

blocks.title: Power
blocks.text: Power us raftar ka paimana hai jis se kaam ho raha hai. Agar waqt delta t mein kaam delta W ho to wuqfe mein ausat power P_av = delta W / delta t ... (4.6). Agar kaam waqt ke function ke taur par likha jaye to kisi bhi lamhe lamhati power P = had (delta t -> 0) delta W / delta t ... (4.7), jahan delta W chhote wuqfe delta t mein kiya kaam hai.

Chunke delta W = F . delta d, P = F . delta d / delta t = F . (delta d / delta t), aur chunke delta d / delta t = v, P = F . v ... (4.8). Power ka SI unit watt hai, jo ek second mein ek joule kaam ke taur par bayan hota hai. Kabhi, maslan bijli ki paimaishon mein, kaam ka unit watt second likha jata hai; bijli ki energy ka tijarti unit kilowatt-hour hai, woh kaam jo ek kilowatt power ka zariya ek ghante mein kare: 1 kW h = 1000 W x 3600 s, ya 1 kW h = 3.6 x 10^6 J = 3.6 MJ.

blocks.title: Example 4.2
blocks.text: 70 kg ka aadmi 4.0 s mein seerhiyon ki lambi urran charhta hai; seerhiyon ki amoodi oonchai 4.5 m hai. Us ki power output watts mein nikalein. Hal: kiya kaam = mgh, power = mgh / t = (70 kg x 9.8 m s^-2 x 4.5 m) / 4 s = 7.7 x 10^2 kg m^2 s^-3 = 7.7 x 10^2 W.
Car banane mein taqreeban 9 x 10^9 J energy lagti hai, aur car phir apni zindagi mein petrol se taqreeban 1 x 10^12 J energy istemal karti hai (Do You Know).

blocks.prompt: Us crane ki power nikalein jo 20 s mein 1000 kg ko 100 m uthaye (short question 4.4). 75 W pankha 30 din rozana 8 ghante chalta hai; units mein energy aur Rs 22.5 fi unit par bill nikalein (numerical 4.5). Machine gun 700 m s^-1 par 40 g ki 6 goliyan fi minute chalati hai; us ki power nikalein (numerical 4.1).
blocks.explanation: P = mgh/t = 1000 x 9.8 x 100 / 20 = 49 000 W = 49 kW. Energy = 0.075 kW x 8 h x 30 = 18 kW h = 18 units, qeemat 18 x 22.5 = Rs 405. Har goli (1/2)(0.040)(700)^2 = 9800 J rakhti hai, chhe fi minute 60 s mein 58 800 J, to P = 980 W (chhapa jawab 9800 W ek goli fi second ke mutabiq hai).

items: Power = kaam karne ki raftar: P_av = delta W / delta t, P = lim delta W / delta t = F . v; unit watt (1 J s^-1); 1 kW h = 3.6 x 10^6 J (tijarti unit). Example 4.2: 7.7 x 10^2 W.
